name: AXM Host Assumption Observatory
actions: inventory exact host and environment assumption tokens
separate filesystem host browser network runtime OS path and environment-variable syntax
show which declared fields carry each assumption
prepare one selected module's bounded unexecuted environment-probe request
summary: Read-only inventory of exact host assumptions plus a bounded request for Touch Environment Probe to inspect one selected module.
notes: This observatory classifies declaration syntax and can emit an unexecuted probe request. It does not inspect the real host, reveal environment values, prove compatibility, install tools, rewrite paths, grant access, or change CANON.
